meta.description: VYBE audio timeline manifest: rhythm skeleton only, no visual effects assigned.
meta.time_unit: seconds, relative to the start of the decoded audio (container duration minus MP3 encoder delay/padding)
meta.timing_accuracy: about +/-12 ms for beat/impact onsets (analysis hop 2.9 ms, refined to local onset peaks)
meta.strength: 0..1 sync importance: BEAT ~0.2-0.5, STRONG_BEAT/DOWNBEAT ~0.55-0.9, IMPACT 0.7-0.99, DROP 0.8-1.0
meta.confidence: 0..1, how sure the detector is; beats_reliable=false means rely on IMPACT events rather than the beat grid
meta.range_events: INTRO, OUTRO, BUILDUP, BREAK, QUIET carry an "end" field; all others are single points
meta.not_emitted: VOCAL_HIT is in the vocabulary but is not emitted: reliable voice detection needs a source-separation model
meta.section_note: SECTION = detected structural segment with no confident musical label
meta.beats_field: beats[] is the full beat grid (time, beat-in-bar 1-4, bar number, onset 0..1). Events that coincide with a beat (within 60 ms) carry beat/bar fields.
meta.tempo_note: bpm is the detected beat-grid tempo; bpm_alternatives lists half/double time. Half/double-time ambiguity is common in phonk/slowed edits.
meta.duplicates: Three byte-identical Wesker files were analysed once; the extra filenames are listed in duplicate_filenames.
